name: Dr. Anil Kumar
summary: Dr. Anil Kumar is a BPT-qualified physiotherapist with 2 years of experience and a focus on neuro physiotherapy. He provides physiotherapy consultations at Medi-Max Health Care Physiotherapy Centre in Vikas Nagar, Uttam Nagar, Delhi, as well as physiotherapy at home. He speaks Hindi and English. Clinic consultations are available from 9 AM to 9 PM, with a consultation fee of ₹200. For appointments, call 7042440793 or request a visit through DOCVY.
